mechanism: Mefloquine can potentiate clonidine's CNS depressant effects and both agents may cause cardiac conduction abnormalities; mefloquine may also increase clonidine levels through CYP3A4 inhibition.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, monitor closely for excessive sedation, hypotension, bradycardia, and neuropsychiatric effects; consider alternative antimalarial agents.
